notes: GST 12.5% (GST Act Cap. 63 s.9(1); an older BTS booklet still printing 10% is pre-2010). Bullion coded 12.5: the complete Act text including Schedules I-V was searched - gold, bullion, precious and silver appear nowhere. Import duty 5% MFN on every HS 7108 line (Belize Customs Schedule of Rates, ch. 71; silver 7106 also 5%, not coded for silver).

sources.name: Attorney General's Ministry (agm.gov.bz) - General Sales Tax Act Cap. 63, s.9(1)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the GST rate is 0% for zero-rated supplies and 12.5% in any other case
sources.quote: The rate of GST applicable to a taxable supply or importation is– (a) if the supply or import is zero-rated under Schedule I, Schedule II or Schedule III, 0%; or (b) in any other case, 12.5%.
